verdict.rationale: Canva ships well-documented Connect APIs with OpenAPI description for client SDK generation, plus Apps SDK/CLI and an official hosted MCP server (confirmed live via runtime probe) enabling AI-native agents to drive design generation, editing, search, and export through natural language. This is a strong, first-party, verifiably live public API/agent surface. Missing for 10: no independent third-party corroboration of API robustness beyond vendor docs/probes, and the raw openapi.json endpoint itself 404s at guessed paths (though OpenAPI description is referenced in docs).
